# General Legal template provenance

Source: https://github.com/General-Legal/legal-templates

Revision: `6d6805425eabd41bed86fc1e2ec51612760f716c` (main checked 31 October 2026).

All 12 Markdown templates and sibling scope notes copied byte for byte. README and CC0 1.0 licence retained. No separate file-level licence was found. CC0 permits commercial adaptation and reuse; attribution is requested by the publisher, not required by CC0. Retain the source credit by default. No original DOCX assets, scripts, connector or paid attorney service installed.

The source does not warrant accuracy or third-party rights. External policies, incorporated legal instruments, actual processing practices, jurisdiction and suitability require per-matter review. The US privacy template has a heading mentioning GDPR despite its US-only title; this inconsistency is recorded in catalog integration notes. Do not treat source marketing claims of compliance as a legal conclusion.
